use_cases: Share content across social media platforms like Twitter, Instagram, and LinkedIn
Copy shareable links to clipboard for easy distribution
Enable social sharing in content-heavy applications like blogs or articles
Provide share functionality in e-commerce product pages
Facilitate social engagement in media and creator platforms
ai_summary: A social sharing button component that expands on hover to reveal share options for major social platforms (Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn) plus link copying. Features smooth motion animations, dark mode support, and clean minimalist styling with Lucide icons. Built as a composite component using the Button primitive with internal state management for active states.
